usage: Narrow per-file exemptions for the workflow-contract test modules described in docs/developers-guide.md#codescene-string-heavy-arguments.

rule_sets.matching_content_path_doc: YAML subset reader: mapping keys and diagnostic contexts are untrusted workflow text, so string arguments are the domain rather than a missing type (issue #257).
Make source parser: every helper consumes Makefile text, where the string is the input language itself (issue #257).
Make conditional and control parser: helpers operate on individual Makefile lines (issue #257).
Make evaluation fixtures: goals, MODE values, commands and expected argv rows are string literals by construction (issue #257).
Workflow argv classifier: reviewed argv tokens are the domain, and a wrapper around the slice would add indirection without an invariant (issue #257).
GNU Make trace reader: source lines, rule targets and recipe text are read and compared as strings (issue #257).
Workflow parser fixtures: each rstest case supplies a command, label, key or YAML snippet as a string literal (issue #257).
